introduction.heading: Introduction
introduction.text: KWETU CONNECT ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our services. Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the site.

informationWeCollect.heading: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.text: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you:
informationWeCollect.item: Register for our programs or services
informationWeCollect.item4: Participate in surveys or feedback forms
informationWeCollect.item6: Apply for employment or volunteer opportunities
informationWeCollect.text2: This information may include: name, email address, phone number, mailing address, date of birth, employment information, cultural background (if voluntarily provided), and any other information you choose to provide.
informationWeCollect.text3: When you visit our website, we may automatically collect certain information about your device, including:
informationWeCollect.item9: Pages visited and time spent on pages

howWeUseYourInformation.heading: How We Use Your Information
howWeUseYourInformation.text: We use the information we collect to:
howWeUseYourInformation.item: Provide, operate, and maintain our services and programs
howWeUseYourInformation.item3: Communicate with you about our programs, events, and services
howWeUseYourInformation.item4: Send you newsletters and updates (with your consent)
howWeUseYourInformation.item5: Respond to your inquiries and provide customer support
howWeUseYourInformation.item8: Comply with legal obligations and protect our rights

informationSharing.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosure
informationSharing.text: We may share your information in the following circumstances:
informationSharing.text2: We may share your information with third parties when you have given us explicit consent to do so.
informationSharing.text3: We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website, conducting our business, or servicing you, provided they agree to keep this information confidential.
informationSharing.text4: We may share information with our partner organizations, including KWETU 4 COMMUNITIES, for the purpose of delivering integrated services and programs.
informationSharing.text5: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities, such as a court or government agency.

dataSecurity.heading: Data Security
dataSecurity.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include:
dataSecurity.item: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
dataSecurity.item5: Secure data storage and backup systems
dataSecurity.text2: However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

yourRights.heading: Your Privacy Rights
yourRights.text: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:
yourRights.item: Request access to your personal information
yourRights.item2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
yourRights.item3: Request deletion of your personal information
yourRights.item4: Object to the processing of your personal information
yourRights.item5: Request restriction of processing your personal information
yourRights.item6: Request transfer of your information to another organization
yourRights.item7: Withdraw your consent at any time where we rely on consent
yourRights.text2: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

cookies.heading: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.text: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our website and hold certain information. Cookies are files with a small amount of data that may include an anonymous unique identifier.
cookies.text2: You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our website.

thirdPartyLinks.heading: Third-Party Websites
thirdPartyLinks.text: Our website may contain links to third-party websites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third-party link, you will be directed to that third party's site. We strongly advise you to review the privacy policy of every site you visit. We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies, or practices of any third-party sites or services.

childrenSPrivacy.heading: Children's Privacy
childrenSPrivacy.text: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us. If we become aware that we have collected personal information from children without verification of parental consent, we take steps to remove that information from our servers.

dataRetention.heading: Data Retention
dataRetention.text: We will retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. When we no longer need your personal information, we will securely delete or anonymize it.

internationalTransfers.heading: International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.text: Your information may be transferred to and maintained on computers located outside of your state, province, country, or other governmental jurisdiction where data protection laws may differ. We will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

changesToPolicy.heading: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changesToPolicy.text: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

contactInformation.heading: Contact Us
contactInformation.text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:

consent.heading: Your Consent
consent.text: By using our website and services, you consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use our website or services.
